attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Delaware state income tax (2025). Simplified top-marginal-rate implementation per 30 Del. C. § 1102: tax = max(AGI - filing-status std ded, 0) x 6.6%. Standard deductions: $3,250 Single/MFS, $6,500 MFJ/QSS, $3,250 HOH. Real brackets are a follow-up. Writes result.computed_state_tax and result.computed_state_taxable_income.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.computed_state_tax = 0; set result.computed_state_taxable_income = 0; add " Delaware Tax Calculation (top marginal 6.6%)" to job.audit_trail; set result.de_military_retirement_exemption = 0.0; perform DE_Military_Pension_Exclusion; add " DE PIT-RES line 6 pension exclusion (military pension): $" + result.de_military_retirement_exemption to job.audit_trail
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: 0 cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef 0 cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef " Delaware Tax Calculation (top marginal 6.6%)" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 cvd /result.de_military_retirement_exemption xdef /DE_Military_Pension_Exclusion performtable " DE PIT-RES line 6 pension exclusion (military pension): $" result.de_military_retirement_exemption strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly or Qualifying Surviving Spouse
condition_details.condition_dsl: job.filing_status is equal to "MFJ" or job.filing_status is equal to "QSS"
condition_details.condition_postfix: job.filing_status "MFJ" streq { pop job.filing_status "QSS" streq } over not if

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Head of Household

action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.state_calc_agi - result.de_military_retirement_exemption - 6500.0) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = result.computed_state_taxable_income * 0.066
action_details.action_postfix: result.state_calc_agi result.de_military_retirement_exemption f- 6500.0 f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.066 fmul cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.state_calc_agi - result.de_military_retirement_exemption - 3250.0) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = result.computed_state_taxable_income * 0.066
action_details.action_postfix: result.state_calc_agi result.de_military_retirement_exemption f- 3250.0 f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.066 fmul cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef

action_details.action_postfix: result.state_calc_agi result.de_military_retirement_exemption f- 3250.0 f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.066 fmul cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: The taxpayer has a United States military pension

Full-year resident entry only. A part-year or nonresident entry's income is built from the income entities, so the pension is not in it, and 4 U.S.C. 114 bars a state from taxing a nonresident's retirement income (#1330 review).

action_details.action_comment: PIT-RES line 6 column B: the lesser of $12,500 and the military pension, any age
action_details.action_dsl: add the minimum of taxpayer.military_retirement_pay and de_military_retirement_exemption_amount to result.de_military_retirement_exemption
action_details.action_postfix: taxpayer.military_retirement_pay de_military_retirement_exemption_amount fmin cvd result.de_military_retirement_exemption f+ /result.de_military_retirement_exemption xdef

policy_statement.policy_description: Pension exclusion for a United States military pension, PIT-RES line 6: the lesser of $12,500 and the pension, under 60 by 30 Del. C. 1106(b)(3) and at 60 or over by the general exclusion (2025 PIT-RES instructions, Line 6). One pension exclusion per taxpayer, so other pension income is not also excluded here.

C. 1106(b)(3) and at 60 or over by the general exclusion (2025 PIT-RES instructions, Line 6). One pension exclusion per taxpayer, so other pension income is not also excluded here."

policy_statement.policy_description: No military pension for this taxpayer.

Not a full-year resident entry: the pension is not in this entry's sourced income (the roster builds it from the income entities) and 4 U.S.C. 114 bars taxing a nonresident's retirement income, so nothing is subtracted.
